To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the network throughput and fairness are both important metrics for evaluating frequency plans in WLANs, and (ii) the proposed frequency planning algorithm is able to provide both high throughput and fairness.

(1) network throughput alone is inadequate as a performance measure of a frequency plan, (2) fairness must be considered as an objective of frequency planning, (3) a novel load model for WLANs is proposed, and (4) a novel frequency planning algorithm is devised which is based on this model
A frequency plan that maximizes network throughput may not be the most fair one.
